text:
maya: FYI the merge of feature/horizon landed but CI is red on linux-x64 shard (only that shard). few failing tests, looks flaky?
ci-bot: Build 1979002468 - https://ci.redwood.com/builds/1979002468 - shard linux-x64 failed (stage: unit-tests). failing tests: KVCacheTest::test_prefetch_race, SerializerTest::test_roundtrip_random. logs attached.
jin: ugh. can someone kick a rerun for that shard first? often clears. :crossed_fingers:
sam: rerun started: https://ci.redwood.com/builds/1979002468/retry/1 (linux-x64). tagging @alex in case it's reproducible locally.
alex: thanks. if rerun fails again i'll bisect the merge range. maya — any nontrivial changes to kv cache in your PR?
maya: only a small prefetch optimization and a nil-check in serializer. i added a timeout in KV prefetch. code: ```go
prefetch(ctx, key, timeout=50ms)
```
jin: the stack in the log shows an assertion in kv_prefetch.go: line 142 (expected cache miss count 0). looks like a race.
qa-bot: flaky test history: KVCacheTest::test_prefetch_race failed 4 times in last 14 days on linux-x64, passes on mac/os. score: medium flakiness.
sam: rerun finished: still failing. moving to bisect. alex do you want the git range?
alex: yes please. maya, which PR commit range covered this merge?
maya: merged main..feature/horizon is commits: c3a1f2..b7d9e4 (merge commit b7d9e4).
alex: ok i'll start `git bisect start --term-old=good --term-new=bad` then `git bisect good c3a1f2` `git bisect bad b7d9e4`. i'll run the two tests locally in a loop: `pytest tests/unit/test_kvcache.py::KVCacheTest::test_prefetch_race -k -x -q` inside `./dev/docker/run_tests.sh --shard linux-x64`
jin: if bisect points to your timeout change, maybe increase timeout or add a retry around the prefetch. also add a deterministic seed for SerializerTest random inputs.
sam: alex, ping here when you have a suspect commit and i'll open a temp revert if needed.
alex: will do. starting bisect now, will update with the commit hash if it reproduces locally.
maya: thanks all — i'm standing by to file a patch. :heart:
qa-bot: automation note: when alex posts bisect result, please include `CI repro url` and `local repro steps` so QA can add a regression test.
alex: update: reproduces locally at commit 5f8d21a (introduced prefetch timeout change). creating a minimal repro and sending patch in a minute.
sam: nice find — please include a testcase that stresses timing so we don't regress. i'll schedule a hotfix branch if patch is small.
maya: i'll review the PR asap.
alex: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4821 — includes fix (backoff+retry) and added deterministic seed for serializer test.
ci-bot: PR 4821 triggered tests. linux-x64 unit shard now green on the PR run.
maya: merging once green. thanks everyone. :tada:
